summary: The agent successfully establishes a baseline LightGBM model with an early-stopping validation scheme and appropriate metric tracking. However, data leakage occurs because imputation, categorical encoding, and variance thresholding are all computed on the full dataset before the train/validation split. Most critically, the agent discards the original test IDs and writes dummy IDs to the submission file, which will completely invalidate the submission.
